items.headline: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Argon to cyber defenders first
items.summary: Google unveiled its new frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, giving early access to cybersecurity defenders through its Fairwind Program before a broader release, with the company touting strong benchmark scores on coding and vulnerability-discovery tasks. Some Google employees reportedly questioned whether the model performs as well on real-world coding work as the benchmarks suggest.

items.headline: Anthropic takes Claude for Government to general availability
items.summary: Anthropic graduated Claude for Government out of beta into general availability inside a FedRAMP High-authorized environment for U.S. federal, state and local agencies, adding early access to the Claude Code CLI and Claude for Microsoft 365. The move deepens the competition among frontier AI labs for public-sector contracts.

items.headline: CoreWeave launches Forge to unify the AI development loop
items.summary: CoreWeave introduced Forge, a development layer combining Weights & Biases tooling, OpenPipe and marimo technology with CoreWeave's own infrastructure to connect model training, observability, evaluation and agent development in one continuous loop. Early adopters cited include Canva and MasterClass.

items.headline: Anthropic reportedly targeting an October IPO that could raise over $60 billion
items.summary: Anthropic is said to be working with Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley on a Nasdaq listing as soon as October 2026, which would make it the first major frontier AI lab to go public, ahead of OpenAI's reported 2027 listing plans.

items.headline: Trump moves to rebrand federal AI push as a 'Super Intelligence Force'
items.summary: President Trump said he plans to stand up an AI advisory and task force under the name 'SI Force,' part of a broader push to replace the term 'artificial intelligence' with 'super intelligence,' and said an AI 'czar' would oversee the effort.

items.headline: Precisely launches AI Studio to speed enterprise AI app development
items.summary: Data-integrity company Precisely released AI Studio, a curated library of ready-made AI apps, agents and skills built to work with tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT, aimed at helping enterprise builders ship AI solutions faster.

items.headline: OpenAI ships GPT-6, constrained to limit risk
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6, described as its most powerful model yet, but reportedly shipped it with deliberate capability constraints intended to limit potential safety and misuse risks, reflecting growing industry caution around frontier model releases.

items.headline: OpenAI's DevDay 2026 brings 20+ announcements across ChatGPT, Codex and agents
items.summary: OpenAI used its DevDay 2026 keynote to unveil more than 20 updates spanning ChatGPT, Codex and its model lineup, with a heavy emphasis on agents that take on ongoing tasks and a vision of ChatGPT as a shared workspace for humans and AI agents to collaborate.

items.headline: 4th Annual AI Regulation Summit convenes government and industry leaders in London
items.summary: Government ministers, regulators and industry leaders gathered in London for the 4th Annual AI Regulation Summit, covering the UK's evolving AI Bill, enforcement of the EU AI Act, and comparative approaches to AI governance worldwide as 2026 marks a shift from AI policy theory to active enforcement.
